content.question: If epsilon is set to 0 in the epsilon-greedy algorithm, how will the agent behave?
options: It will always exploit, choosing the best known action every time.
It will always explore, choosing a random action every time.
It will alternate equally between exploration and exploitation.
It will behave exactly the same as with epsilon = 1.
content.answer: It will always exploit, choosing the best known action every time.
